issue.title: Crash-safe per-session prompt-draft journal recovered into Stash on next TUI start

task_type_fields.proposal:
A crash-safe, per-session prompt-draft journal for the ACE TUI. While a prompt bar holds a non-empty draft, periodically autosave it (debounced on edits plus a timer) to a per-session journal file under SASE_HOME. Remove the entry when the draft is submitted, stashed, or explicitly discarded. On the next TUI start, import any leftover journal entries into Stash with `source="recovered"` (through the guarded `prompt_stash_facade`) and toast how many were recovered.

This covers the exits that epic sase-1ca could not: SIGKILL, OOM kill, terminal/tmux window close, and host crash with a draft open. sase-1ca deliberately does not stash from signal handlers.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved sase-1ca plan ("Never lose stashed prompts") listed this under "Out of scope and follow-up candidates". That epic fixed the stash, restore, capture, and explicit quit paths and added the append-only stash archive. A journal is a new persistence mechanism with its own lifecycle, import semantics, and junk-row risk for agent- or screenshot-driven TUIs, so it needs its own design.

issue.creation_reason: The approved sase-1ca plan listed this as an out-of-scope follow-up candidate, and no phase worker recorded it, so the sase-1ca land agent routed it as a proposal.
